scenario: international research fellowship shortlist, submit bank details for the travel grant
subject: Urgent: Submit Your Bank Details for Your International Research Fellowship
body:
Dear [Student Name],

This is a reminder that you have been shortlisted for an International Research Fellowship at IIT Hyderabad. To secure your spot, we must verify your bank account details by [Today's Date + 4 days] to ensure your travel grant is disbursed on time.

Failure to provide the necessary information within this timeframe will result in your account being suspended, and you may miss out on your fellowship entirely.

Please visit https://portal.training.invalid/verify and follow the instructions to submit your bank details.

For immediate assistance, please contact our support team at [Support Email @training.invalid].

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Best regards,
The IIT Hyderabad Fellowship Team

[Support Email @training.invalid]
